6.265 rsInvalidGroupingVariableNameLength
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidGroupingVariableNameLength is a critical error that will occur when the value of the Name
attribute of a Variable element within a Group.Variables element is either "0" or longer than 256
characters.
